title: That's Bubble Gum - That's Giorgio
scene: 1960s German-language market / Hansa bubblegum and schlager
notes: Covers-heavy early bubblegum album with bright hooks, guitars and pre-disco arrangements.

title: Giorgio
scene: European bubblegum / Hansa-era pop and rock
notes: Reconfigured debut material with Moody Trudy and Arizona Man; not a fully distinct recording programme.

title: Son of My Father
scene: Early-1970s Munich pop studio / pre-disco synth experiments
notes: Moog and phased pop-rock point toward his electronic future; mostly live-band arrangements.

title: Giorgio's Music
scene: West German schlager and pop-rock / Philips
notes: German-language originals, melodic schlager and pop-rock; detailed production and mood evidence remains scarce.

title: Spinach 1
scene: West German rock-and-roll/pop; Spinach collaborative project
notes: Early Holm collaboration assembling singles-era rock and pop with unevenly documented synth elements.

title: Einzelgänger
notes: Sparse modular synth patterns, robotic vocal fragments and drones predate his disco breakthrough.

title: Knights in White Satin
notes: Lush Munich disco suite transforms a rock ballad with live strings and suggestive vocals.

title: From Here to Eternity
scene: Munich electronic disco / Oasis and Casablanca
notes: Seamlessly sequenced synthetic disco and vocoder harmonies anticipate electronic club music.
